Foundation repair services in Spring, TX

Every job starts with a free inspection and a written report, so you know what your home needs before any work begins. Choose a service for the signs, causes, process and typical cost in Spring.

01 Foundation Settlement Repair Pressed concrete or steel pilings under a settled slab, followed by a controlled lift. 02 Slab Heave Repair Diagnosis and repair of slabs pushed upward by swelling clay or under-slab leaks. 03 Slab Leak Detection & Repair Pressure testing and leak location for water and drain lines under the slab. 04 Foundation Crack Repair Diagnosis and repair of slab, grade beam and brick veneer cracking. 05 Foundation Inspection A free floor elevation survey with a written report for owners, buyers and sellers. 06 Brick & Corner Pop Repair Repair of cracked slab corners and the brick veneer above them. 07 Post-Tension Cable Repair Locating and repairing broken or exposed tendons in post-tension slabs. 08 Foundation Re-Leveling Raising settled sections toward the original plane on slab or pier and beam. 09 Pier and Beam Foundation Repair Re-shimming, new support piers and sill or joist replacement for raised homes. 10 Foundation Drainage Solutions French drains, surface drains and downspout tie-ins that control perimeter moisture. 11 Slab Void Fill & Stabilization Filling empty spaces under the slab left by washout, leaks or shrinking soil. 12 Commercial Repair Engineered repairs for retail, office, church and multifamily structures.
